sentence_stem: Had the committee been consulted earlier,
correct_completion: the proposal would have been revised long ago.
full_sentence: Had the committee been consulted earlier, the proposal would have been revised long ago.
acceptable_variants: the proposal might have been revised sooner.
the revision would have started much earlier.

options.text: so the proposal was revised quickly.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result of something already happened, not a hypothetical outcome; the inverted 'Had' requires a past conditional result clause.

options.text: the proposal is being revised now.
options.why_wrong: The present progressive does not match the past hypothetical created by 'Had ... been consulted'.

options.text: the proposal would have been revised long ago.
we will revise the proposal tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future time reference ignores the past conditional meaning set up by the inverted 'Had' clause.

explanation: The inverted 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'If', so the main clause needs 'would have + past participle' to express an unreal past situation.
translation: لو اطلعت اللجنة على الأمر مبكراً لكان قد جرى تعديل المقترح منذ زمن طويل.
